_doc: Brand tokens for the club/group og:image template. Swap this file (and the files it points to) to rebrand. Paths are relative to this file. See og-club-template.md.

pattern._doc: Tartan sett, one colour per equal stripe unit, drawn as warp (vertical) plus weft (horizontal at weft_opacity). Fraser of Lovat: R R R W R R R G Navy G.
pattern.name: Fraser of Lovat

mark._doc: Square SVG mark shown in the medallion. recolor maps literal strings in the mark SVG to replacements; {pattern} becomes the brand pattern scaled to mark_unit (in the mark's own viewBox units) and rotated mark_rotate degrees. Set svg to null for no mark.
